units.source_text: 每當我忙碌完地下運動身心俱疲地回到房間，飯也不吃地躺在床上時，

en.t: Whenever I came back to my room exhausted in body and mind after busying myself with underground activities, and lay down on the bed without even eating,

units.source_text: 她一定會拿著信箋和鋼筆來到我的房間。

en.t: she would always come to my room carrying writing paper and a fountain pen.

units.source_text: 「抱歉，樓下弟弟妹妹太吵，一封信都無法坐下來寫。」

en.t: "I'm sorry. My younger brothers and sisters downstairs are so noisy that I can't even sit down to write a single letter."

units.source_text: 說罷就坐在我的桌子旁，一寫就是一個多小時。

en.t: After saying that, she would sit beside my desk and write for more than an hour.

units.source_text: 我原本可以佯裝什麼也不知道地躺著，

en.t: I could have simply lain there pretending not to know anything,

units.source_text: 可那姑娘好像希望我能對她說些什麼，所以我又發揮了被動的服務精神。

en.t: but the girl seemed to want me to say something to her, so once again I put my passive spirit of service to work.

units.source_text: 事實上我一句話也不想說，只是勉強用疲憊的身軀打起精神，

en.t: In truth, I did not want to say a word, but I forced my exhausted body to rouse itself,

units.source_text: 趴在床上邊抽菸邊說道：「聽說有個男人，

en.t: and lying face down on the bed while smoking, I said, "I hear there was a man

units.source_text: 用女人寫給他的情書燒水洗澡。」

en.t: who heated his bathwater with love letters women had written to him."
